title: Research on the mechanism of berberine in the treatment of COVID-19 pneumonia pulmonary fibrosis using network pharmacology and molecular docking.
authors: Cao, Junfeng; Li, Lianglei; Xiong, Li; Wang, Chaochao; Chen, Yijun; Zhang, Xiao
journal: Phytomedicine plus : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络药理学和分子对接研究小檗碱治疗新冠肺纤维化的机制，虽涉及分子对接但对象为药物-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联极弱。
abstract: Purpose Pulmonary fibrosis caused by COVID-19 pneumonia is a serious complication of COVID-19 infection, there is a lack of effective treatment methods clinically. This article explored the mechanism of action of berberine in the treatment of COVID-19 (Corona Virus Disease 2019, COVID-19) pneumonia pulmonary fibrosis with the help of the network pharmacology and molecular docking. Methods We predicted the role of berberine protein targets with the Pharmmapper database and the 3D structure of berberine in the Pubchem database. And GeneCards database was used in order to search disease target genes and screen common target genes. Then we used STRING web to construct PPI interaction network of common target protein. The common target genes were analyzed by GO and KEGG by DAVID database. The disease-core target gene-drug network was established and molecular docking was used for prediction. We also analyzed the binding free energy and simulates molecular dynamics of complexes. Results Berberine had 250 gene targets, COVID-19 pneumonia pulmonary fibrosis had 191 gene targets, the intersection of which was 23 in common gene targets. Molecular docking showed that berberine was associated with CCl2, IL-6, STAT3 and TNF-alpha. GO and KEGG analysis reveals that berberine mainly plays a vital role by the signaling pathways of influenza, inflammation and immune response. Conclusion Berberine acts on TNF-alpha, STAT3, IL-6, CCL2 and other targets to inhibit inflammation and the activation of fibrocytes to achieve the purpose of treating COVID-19 pneumonia pulmonary fibrosis.
abstract_zh: 目的 新冠肺炎(COVID-19)肺炎所致肺纤维化是COVID-19感染的严重并发症，临床上缺乏有效的治疗方法。本文借助网络药理学和分子对接探讨小檗碱治疗COVID-19肺炎肺纤维化的作用机制。方法 利用Pharmmapper数据库预测小檗碱蛋白靶点，并从Pubchem数据库获取小檗碱的三维结构。使用GeneCards数据库检索疾病靶基因，并筛选共同靶基因。然后利用STRING网络构建共同靶蛋白的PPI相互作用网络。通过DAVID数据库对共同靶基因进行GO和KEGG分析。建立疾病-核心靶基因-药物网络，并采用分子对接进行预测。我们还分析了复合物的结合自由能，并模拟了分子动力学。结果 小檗碱有250个基因靶点，COVID-19肺炎肺纤维化有191个基因靶点，其中共同基因靶点有23个。分子对接显示，小檗碱与CCl2、IL-6、STAT3和TNF-α相关。GO和KEGG分析表明，小檗碱主要通过流感、炎症和免疫应答的信号通路发挥重要作用。结论 小檗碱作用于TNF-α、STAT3、IL-6、CCL2等靶点，抑制炎症和纤维细胞活化，以达到治疗COVID-19肺炎肺纤维化的目的。
